releaseHistoryV0Label.message: v2.6.0 - Smoother interface, special-day icons, Undo

releaseHistoryV0Body.message:
• Smoother interface: cards glide into place when a channel goes live, newly live channels get a short green ring, the bell rings when you turn it on and tabs slide
• Pause and "Mute for 1 hour" show the time left as a ring around the icon
• Cleaner cards: the bell and the star are always visible, the other buttons appear when you point at a card
• Undo: removing a favorite, clearing the notification history, deleting a group or removing a chat word can be undone from the bar at the bottom
• Empty lists now tell you what to do next
• Special-day icons: on a few holidays in your region the toolbar icon gets a themed look (you can turn this off in Settings)
• Multi-Stream: the stream with sound shows a small equalizer, and tiles slide when you change the layout
• One icon style everywhere, and the sort bar stays on top while you scroll
• New website: segelferd.github.io/kick-alert

releaseHistoryV1Label.message: v2.5.111 - Pause, chat radar, event sounds, Multi-Stream

releaseHistoryV1Body.message:
• Pause notifications for 1 hour or until morning from the top bar; the second button on a Chrome notification mutes that channel for 1 hour
• A "Will this channel notify you?" check in each channel's settings lists everything that can stop an alert
• Background chat radar: get notified when your username or chosen words are written in up to 5 channels, even with no Kick tab open
• 10 new sounds made for raids, stream end, stream moved and category changes, with a separate sound for each event
• Multi-Stream: streams start muted, listen to one stream with a single click, chat drawer on the side
• Optional alert when a streamer moves their stream to another channel, and an option to close auto-opened tabs when that happens
• Compact card layout; chat alert settings stay hidden while Chat integration is off
• Chat filters also catch disguised spelling (look-alike letters, invisible characters, spaced-out letters)
• Bot score uses Kick's own chatter count from the first minute and accounts for all chat modes
• Backup realtime connection if Kick's main service goes quiet
• Tooltips that stayed in English now follow your language, and the wording was polished in several languages
• Fixes: settings changed in the popup no longer revert with Cloud Sync on; Multi-Stream players work with the extra kick.com permission; the toolbar card lists live channels on Chrome

releaseHistoryV2Label.message: v2.5.87 - Bot score on Firefox, permissions, ad blocking fix

releaseHistoryV2Body.message:
• Bot score now works on Firefox too, just like on Chrome
• After an update, a short guide lists any site permission that is off, explains why it is needed and lets you turn it on
• Firefox: requests through an open Kick tab work again
• Ad blocking: blocking of ad servers now really works (KickAlert asks for access to ad domains when you turn it on)
• No more black screen at the end of a stream when ad blocking is on
• Bot score accounts for slow mode and subscriber-only chat from the start
• The new "Extension permissions" section in Options shows which permissions are on and turns on any that are off with a single click; if one is off, a notice appears above the channel list
